dataset_fingerprint_sql:
SELECT row_json
FROM (
    SELECT 'orders:' || jsonb_build_array(o_orderkey, o_orderstatus)::text AS row_json
    FROM benchmark.orders
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'lineitem:' || jsonb_build_array(l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_extendedprice::text)::text AS row_json
    FROM benchmark.lineitem
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'nonce:' || jsonb_build_array(nonce_id)::text AS row_json
    FROM benchmark.provenance_nonce
) AS canonical_dataset
ORDER BY row_json

workloads.sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_array(
           grouped.o_orderstatus::text,
           coalesce(grouped.price, NULL::numeric)::text,
           coalesce(grouped.lines, NULL::bigint)::text,
           coalesce(grouped.members, NULL::bigint)::text
       )::text AS row_json,
       grouped.price AS price_provenance,
       grouped.lines AS line_provenance,
       grouped.members AS count_provenance
FROM (
    SELECT o.o_orderstatus,
           sum(l.l_extendedprice) AS price,
           sum(l.l_linenumber) AS lines,
           count(*) AS members
    FROM benchmark.orders AS o
    JOIN benchmark.lineitem AS l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN benchmark.provenance_nonce AS nonce ON nonce.nonce_id = $2
    WHERE o.o_orderkey <= $1
    GROUP BY o.o_orderstatus
) AS grouped
ORDER BY grouped.o_orderstatus
